_comment: Starter prompts shown as chips to a student who does not know what to ask. label = chip text (short); message = what is sent to the tutor. 'meta' chips apply to every course; each course id has its own list. tutor/agent/starters.py samples a few per student and adds a personalized pair from the navigator.

meta.label: What can you help me with?
meta.message: What can you help me with, and how do I get the most out of you?

meta.label: How do your hints work?
meta.message: How do your hints work? Why won't you just give me the full answer?

AST101.label: Why does the Moon have phases?
AST101.message: Why does the Moon go through phases? Is it Earth's shadow?

AST101.label: What causes the seasons?
AST101.message: What actually causes the seasons? Isn't Earth closer to the Sun in summer?

AST101.label: Why no eclipse every month?
AST101.message: If the Moon goes around Earth every month, why don't we get an eclipse every month?

AST101.label: Measure the sky with my hand
AST101.message: How do I measure angles on the sky with my hand? Give me one to try.

AST101.label: Why do bigger telescopes matter?
AST101.message: Why is a bigger telescope better? Is it about magnification?

AST102.label: How far away is that star?
AST102.message: How do astronomers measure the distance to a star? Walk me through parallax, but let me try the math.

AST102.label: Read the H-R diagram
AST102.message: How do I read an H-R diagram? Where would the Sun be?

AST102.label: How will the Sun die?
AST102.message: How will the Sun end its life, and why won't it become a black hole?

AST102.label: What is dark matter evidence?
AST102.message: What is the evidence for dark matter from galaxy rotation curves?

AST102.label: Hubble's law practice
AST102.message: Give me a Hubble's law problem to try, and check my answer.
